# QudSchool

> QudSchool (كود سكول) is an AI-powered educational platform teaching programming, computer science, robotics, game development, and AI to children and youth. Interactive courses, hands-on projects, and modern curricula — in Arabic (RTL) and English (LTR).

Founded by Hossam Galal in 2023. Team: Hassan Orabi, Omar Essam, Amr Mohamed Galal.
Trusted by 2,000+ students. Partners: Google, Microsoft, MIT, Stanford, UNICEF.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://qudschool.com/): Platform overview, programs, learning approach.
- [Courses](https://qudschool.com/courses): Programming and computer science catalog.
- [Live Sessions](https://qudschool.com/live-sessions): Live 1:1, group (1:6), and family classes with certified instructors.
- [Pricing](https://qudschool.com/pricing): Plans and pricing.
- [About](https://qudschool.com/about): Mission, team, values, and story.
- [Instructors](https://qudschool.com/instructors): Meet the team behind QudSchool.
- [Certifications](https://qudschool.com/certifications): Certified completion certificates, portfolios, and credentials.
- [Blog](https://qudschool.com/blog): Articles and guides on teaching programming and AI to kids.
- [FAQ](https://qudschool.com/faq): Direct answers to common questions.
- [Contact](https://qudschool.com/contact): Get in touch with our team.
- [Success Stories](https://qudschool.com/success-stories): Testimonials and outcomes.
- [Privacy Policy](https://qudschool.com/privacy-policy) · [Terms of Service](https://qudschool.com/terms-of-service)
